_design: Full endgame gauntlet — every mechanic in one chunk. Phase 1 (0-1.5s): vine + sinking-log launch (same setup as d8, requires clean execution). Phase 2 (1.5-3s): mynock swarm (3 dives, alternating timing). Phase 3 (3-4.8s): vine + slime exit with holocron at the precise apex. Solvable but unforgiving — meant to be the chunk that decides a top-rank run.
